# New-act participation after canonical settled correction — separate reference

**2026-10-27 · base2d44a67 · pre-code engineering/coverage contract, not scientific registration or a new owner rule.** BACKLOG owns work. The fixed year exposed converted-v1's day270 refusal of n41's NEW day250 act because15older D59-void records persist. Preserve that profile/packet/refusal and historical caller bytes. This is not protocol immunity and not permission to restore old tokens/XP or reopen an already-corrected act.

## Smallest owner/semantics change

Only src/accountability.mjs gains participationReference:'d77-timed-act-settled-history/v1', with the SAME timed ACT/reserved168h/stake1/growth0.1/ordinary absent-Council constructor requirements and D77 lifecycle. No Model/graph/stakes/new API/module/framework/registry. Existing one-step/default/timed-converted references keep their exact behavior and errors.

For NEW profile only, each accepted current debt-free party's own records must be either:

- Ordinary live converted/unlocked collector disposition, unchanged pending/debt/identity restrictions.
- Cancelled/unlocked canonical D59 resolution history: an actual upheld Model.selfIdResolutions record with the same subject and exact source membership, kind self-correction→self-corrected OR external-chain-cut→adjudicated-void, matching current status/disposition, and any existing XP receipt already revoked. Read canonical Model data, not an external allowed-ID/cache/graph label. A null XP receipt is not fabricated XP. This check only admits historical settled state; it MUST NOT mutate it.

No arbitrary guarantor veto, legacy chain void, invitation/debt-consumed source, fake/rejected resolution, live/unspent/locked/debt or invalid identity is admitted by this compatibility. Do not turn a legacy converted+voided record into an ordinary live collector record. These new-profile boundaries do NOT silently change converted-v1's existing predicate or research meaning. D59 remains the trusted source executor, not evidence/authority authentication; recognition of a stored record does not prove historical merits.

The targeted NEW Self-ID remains a converted, uncorrected source handled by the existing native preview; targeting an already-corrected/voided act still refuses before stake/hold. Old case records, chainIndex/previousSelfId, cancelled source dispositions, revocation times/recipients, prior recovered/burned/debt figures and balances are not restored. New external suffix plans must exclude all earlier settled source IDs and never recollect their principal. Strict XP/current cash/evidence/public opposition/derived finality/overlap-safe D77/punitive-Council-termination limits are unchanged. No unrelated OPENs selected.

## Literal regressions before code

Reuse existing timedWorld/owner, optional helper profile argument with old default unchanged. Two matched references first execute the same real case on author middle source at24, final457: suffix2 actually collected and XP3→1. Then author legitimately issues/withdraws two NEW sources at457→481 and481→505 (positions4/5, predecessors retained), earns2new units and reaches3XP/3liquid without any restoration. A second reviewed claim targets position4 at505:

- Converted-v1 still refuses because old positions2/3are cancelled. No new stake/hold or implicit legal rejection.
- Settled-history reference admits. Final674 derives a new upheld suffix4/5, collects2NEW units, authorXP3→1/liquid3→1. Initial25 +new2 minted27, total source recovery/burn4 across disjoint2+2 sources, supply23. Earlier prefix and first settlement/old cancelled records byte-identical; original case funds/revocations not repeated. No supplied Boolean in the new court path.

Also cover canonical author self-correction history and a later entrant with settled own history, current debt/frozen/pending/noncanonical veto/legacy void/invitation-consumed histories refused, corrected-act retargeting refused, original v1 still failing canonical history. Existing default/one-step/timed v1 bodies/guards remain. Prefer few property families, no scenario grid.

## Distinct same-caller profile comparison, before data

Keep longitudinal-caller.mjs and its contract/results bytes immutable. A separate captured specialization longitudinal-settled-history-caller.mjs is EXACTLY that fixed175-line caller with ONE literal replacement of the profile identifier. It is an evidence artifact specialization, not a new backend or duplicated maintained framework; do not refactor old historical source to add tuning hooks. Assert exact source equality after reverting that one literal and retain separate script/design digests. All H365/60genesis/26paid birth demand/guarantee schedules/evidence/action/private-fact tape/budgets/absence of Council stay unchanged,90s bound/no favorable retries.

Archive pre-code Source/examples. After focused/full754+new current and21original compatible historical/DAG/default keyed/walkthrough/two trajectory tests, run original v1 caller on the changed Source: every original field must match old V2 raw except implementation provenance. Run the distinct settled-history specialization as a separately labeled new-profile result. A changed case outcome after270 may be a legitimate dependent trajectory consequence, not a behavioral claim. Before day270, all protocol/state/daily/action fields match aside from profile/design/script/provenance tags; don't exclude arbitrary economics to force equality. Require actual admission (or precise new blocker) of the repeat NEW-act request; do not require favorable procedural winner, corrected truth, reduced losses or all cases winning. No restoration/double principal at horizon; real recovery/debt/XP/holds remain audited and source-disjoint.

## Ceiling / next boundary

This closes one demonstrated reference-coverage hole, not a default/general court, restored reputation/remedy law, D34 punitive merits, G1 or a scientific defense/capture/equilibrium result. Prior valid-target cuts and private signal assumptions are not magically repaired. No aliases/endogenous humans/market/utility or real data is supplied. Preserve old study bytes/source/RNG identities and report new Source/arm provenance separately. After the fixed compatibility comparison, return to the highest remaining causal/method/scenario gap under the existing master; do not build infrastructure or a favorable sweep for momentum.
